regime_context: The Canada/TSX detector shows a broad, non-directional commodity-led regime: Base Metals & Copper narrowly leads Oil & Gas Producers (margin 0.11) with both eligible and above the trend-gate, while absolute-trend discipline is validated on this market (gate_helps=true), so trend-lean selection is legitimate. No single narrative dominates (breadth 0.56, one_narrative=false); the rotation read is display-only. Note the track_record: 66.3% hit_rate but only 34.7% directional accuracy on 95 calls — consistent with the detector being a risk-control lens, not a return forecaster, so conviction should be modest.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed handoff from Base Metals to Oil & Gas Producers: since the rotation margin is only 0.11 and Oil & Gas has a higher durability_bar (0.61 vs 0.50), the condition that retires this watch is XEG.TO taking and holding the rank-1 score for three consecutive sessions on rising breadth above 0.6.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: The leader is eligible, above-trend, scorable, and not crowded (crowding_z 0.9), with the highest score (1.655) and the strongest theme-level durability bar (0.50) among non-energy Materials. The trend-gate leg supports staying long if price holds above trend; rotation margin of 0.11 is thin, so the lean is directional only, never sized.
theses.dissent: The detector's own backtest verdict says relative momentum rank-IC is weak/insignificant — leadership is an attention lens, not alpha. Hurst tag 'mean-revert' warns the theme tends to snap back; breadth 0.556 is only moderate, and the narrow rotation margin means a fast reversal to Oil & Gas is plausible.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO closes below its 50-day trailing average and yields its rank-1 slot to Oil & Gas Producers (XEG.TO) before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities is ineligible (score -0.217, durability_bar 0.31) and carries the weakest materials-adjacent energy-carry score among eligible-adjacent defensives, with a 'trend' Hurst tag suggesting persistence of the decline. The absolute-trend gate justifies avoiding/underweighting a theme that failed its eligibility test.
theses.dissent: A risk-off macro shift (unscheduled_share 0.4) or a rates reprieve could rotate money back into defensives/yield; Utilities has been a crowded short, and mean-reversion in sentiment could produce a sharp counter-trend bounce that a trend-gate would be late to catch.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO closes up 6% from its level as of 2026-10-02 while the S&P/TSX is flat or down before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
